lines.text: Sam started up the trail before sunrise.
It was below freezing, and twenty minutes in, his headlamp was already dimming.
Here's the fix. Charge it full the night before.
Keep the lamp in an inside pocket, close to your body, until you need it.
And always carry a backup light.
Next cold morning: gloves on, sensor mode on, one wave of his hand, and the light came on.
Save this before your next early start.
